name: USDD
oneLiner: USDD is the Tron DAO Reserve's CDP-and-PSM stablecoin, designed as overcollateralized but historically traded below peg through multiple stress episodes.
collateral: Current reserves are split across Smart Allocator stablecoin deployments, TRX and sTRX CDP vault collateral, and USDT held in PSM/direct vaults; Bitcoin was removed from reserves in August 2024
pegMechanism: CDP model with minimum 130% collateral ratio; Peg Stability Module enables 1:1 minting/redemption against USDT and USDC

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDD is presented as a TRON DAO Reserve dollar stablecoin for payments with over-collateralized reserves and PSM swap/redemption mechanics.

genius.notes: USDD has reserve and swap/redemption disclosures, but no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for USDD.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Freeze-only re-review: USDD has no confirmed direct holder-balance freeze in reviewed metadata, but resolves to Upstream through stablecoin reserve and DeFi exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDD resolves to Upstream through USDT/USDC PSM and stablecoin DeFi exposure rather than direct token freeze authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDD mints through Maker-style collateralized TRON DAO Reserve rails; Ethereum token source exposes warded mint authority and the USDD Join contract is the resolved direct minter, while governance/Pause/Vat administration remains unresolved.

controls.label: USDD Join token ward / direct minter
controls.evidence: USDD system/deployment docs describe collateralized USDD issuance rails, and Ethereum token source exposes warded mint authority. Live/source review identifies the USDD Join contract as the token ward/direct minter rather than a generic privileged token authority.

controls.label: USDD governance / Pause / Vat administration
controls.evidence: System-level governance, Pause, and Vat administration can alter issuance parameters or privileged wards; exact current signer set and threshold were not decoded in this pass.

review.evidence: USDD docs describe collateralized issuance architecture and deployment addresses; token-source review identifies USDD Join as the direct ward/minter while governance/Pause/Vat authority remains unresolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve USDD governance/Pause/Vat signer thresholds and current ward-management authority before raising confidence.
